findings.title: Stale v6 carry-over states that current measurement relies on G31 occupancy v2, contradicting the artifact's own consumed-specification claim and D-293 A3
findings.quote: Historical superseded G31 specification. Occupies the path naming v1 named. Independent review completed as Claude REJECT 0/1 CLAUDE-G31-V1-SF1. v2 lands that finding. This join does not treat v1 as the current specification and does not claim v1 is independently ACCEPTED. Current measurement relies on v2 and its pinned review.
findings.defect: The closing sentence 'Current measurement relies on v2 and its pinned review.' is present tense and false at v7. The field is byte-identical to v6, where it was true: v6 consumed occupancy v2 (basedOn.predecessorV6.role, 'Consumed occupancy v2'). The whole warrant of this successor is that the consumed specification moves to occupancy v5 and occupancy v2 becomes historical, so the version bump falsified this sentence and it was not updated.
contradictedBy: authorityClaim: 'It cites G31 occupancy v5 (D-208) as the consumed specification and marks occupancy v2 historical.'
basedOn.g31SpecV2.role: 'identity-namespace leftover-join.v7 consumes occupancy v5, not occupancy v2.'
basedOn.occupancyV5.role: 'Consumed specification of identity-namespace leftover-join.v7. ... Occupancy v2 is historical.'
obligations.OBL-G31-HARNESS-SPEC.reason: '... is the current G31 occupancy. ... identity-namespace leftover-join.v7 consumes occupancy v5.'
purpose: 'Cite G31 occupancy v5 as the consumed specification. Mark occupancy v2 historical.'
findings.whyMustFix: This is the prompt's named attack 'occupancy v2 still consumed as current', landing inside the artifact's own basedOn ledger. D-293 A3 authorizes the successor only if it 'cites G31 occupancy v5 (D-208) as the consumed specification, marks v2 historical'. A recorded artifact that simultaneously says current measurement relies on v2 and that it consumes v5 leaves the consumed specification indeterminate on the face of the record, which is exactly what a bookkeeping successor exists to fix. It is also self-contradictory, so it cannot be read as a scoped historical remark.
findings.aggravating: The same sentence uses bare 'v1' and 'v2' with no lineage stem while the artifact carries three concurrent vN lineages (the join, the G31 specification/occupancy, the gate naming), so the tokens are ambiguous as well as stale.
findings.suggestedRemedy: Restem and re-date the field to the v7 measurement, e.g.: 'Historical superseded G31 specification. Occupies the path gate naming v1 named. Independent review completed as Claude REJECT 0/1 CLAUDE-G31-V1-SF1, which G31 occupancy v2 lands. identity-namespace leftover-join.v7 does not treat G31 occupancy v1 as the current specification and does not claim it is independently ACCEPTED. Current measurement relies on G31 occupancy v5 (D-208) and its pinned reviews; G31 occupancy v2 is historical.' Remedy is wording only — it does not touch leftoverDesign, the partition, the file 08 token, or D-236.

findings.title: The authorizing warrant D-293 A3 is never cited; authorityClaim leans on a bare, unresolvable 'A3' token
findings.quote: This artifact PROPOSES an execution-remainder join successor for DR-104 leftovers. identity-namespace leftover-join.v7 is the A3 bookkeeping successor of identity-namespace leftover-join.v6.
findings.defect: 'D-293' appears zero times in the subject. The artifact asserts A3 standing without naming the decision that confers it, and basedOn carries no d293 entry even though it carries d012, d056, d175, d208, d236 and d312. A reader cannot resolve 'A3' from the artifact alone.
findings.evidence: D-293 (COORD L16169, ADOPTED 2026-08-28) item 3 is the warrant: 'A3 (identity-namespace leftover-join.v6). Authorizes the bookkeeping successor v7 exactly as agreed (cites G31 occupancy v5 (D-208) as the consumed specification, marks v2 historical, re-pins live file 08 with DR-104's SATISFIED token verbatim, states that it neither replaces nor reopens D-236), through the normal Stage A + Stage B dual review, zero readiness effect, lowest priority.' Sibling successors authored under the same warrant cite it explicitly: component-manifest leftover-join.v15 (9 occurrences), distribution-core leftover-join.v10 (13), signed-index leftover-join.v8 (13). None of them uses a bare 'A3'.
findings.whyShouldFix: The four substantive A3 requirements are otherwise met, so this is a traceability and house-consistency defect rather than a substantive one. But a CANDIDATE whose entire authority is D-293 A3 should carry that citation the way its siblings do, and the bare token is precisely the unanchored-reference class this lane rejects on.
findings.suggestedRemedy: Add a basedOn.d293 entry pinning docs/coop/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md's D-293 heading (recording D-293, commit as applicable, role: warrant, A3, authorizes this successor; not last-heading; not this artifact's version number), add the corresponding recordedInputs pin, and restem authorityClaim to 'the D-293 A3 bookkeeping successor'.

decision.rule: ACCEPT only if no MUST-FIX or SHOULD-FIX.
decision.basis: The artifact is substantively sound: the partition is carried intact, the file 08 token move to SATISFIED is correct against live bytes, occupancy v5 is properly consumed, D-236 is neither replaced nor reopened, and every declared digest verifies. It fails on two wording-and-traceability defects. basedOn.g31SpecV1.role carries a sentence from v6 that the version bump falsified — it still says current measurement relies on occupancy v2 — which is the prompt's named attack and contradicts D-293 A3's core requirement. Separately, the authorizing warrant D-293 is never cited.
decision.remedyClass: Both findings are wording-only. Neither requires touching leftoverDesign, the obligation partition, the file 08 token, required-now, or any recorded decision. A v8 that restems basedOn.g31SpecV1.role onto occupancy v5 and adds the D-293 A3 warrant citation should clear Stage A.
